summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature by reading and editing files only; nothing was run or committed. Changes: rich/progress.py gets a private reader class, a private context wrapper, a shared column/Progress helper, module-level open (text/binary overloads) and wrap_file beside track(), and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods. tests/test_progress.py gains 16 new tests before the script block. docs/source/progress.rst gains "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections before "Multiple Progress". CHANGELOG.md gets one Added bullet linking PR 1759. The diff is purely additive (758 insertions, 0 deletions). Not verified: tests were not run and mypy was not run, per instructions. Two tests assume Progress.refresh() with a None total does not fail when the live display is not started. The type: ignore[return-value, type-var] on module-level open may be unnecessary; it was kept as the spec lists it. Choices made: the write error message is "write"; a task is created before the file is opened, as the spec orders it, so a failed open leaves that task behind.
